# 00. Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(magrittr)
```

# 0. Raw data
```{r}
raw_dir <- if (dir.exists("R/data/raw")) "R/data/raw" else "data/raw"

t_zeng_data <- read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, "zeng_replication_data.csv"))

t_zhang_data <- read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, "zhang_replication_data.csv"))

t_yang_data <- read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, "yang_replication_data.csv"))

t_primeprobe_data <- read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, "bognar_primeprobe_data.csv"))

t_flanker_data <- read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, "bognar_flanker_data.csv"))
```

# ==============================================================
# 1. Zeng
### preprocessed
```{r}
zeng_raw <- t_zeng_data %>%
  select(
    trial_index, participant_id, rt, correct, first_trial, congruency, condition
  ) %>%
  rename(cong = congruency) %>%
  mutate(
    participant_id = paste0(participant_id, "_zeng"),
    study = "zeng"
  ) %>%
  arrange(participant_id, trial_index) %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_cong = lag(cong, n = 1),
    prev_correct = lag(correct, n = 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

zeng_processed <- zeng_raw %>%
  mutate(
    cong = if_else(cong == "incongruent", -1, 1),
    prev_cong = case_when(
      is.na(prev_cong) ~ NA_real_,
      prev_cong == "incongruent" ~ -1,
      TRUE ~ 1
    )
  )
```

### creating block index (pos, neg, neutral)
```{r}
zeng_block <- zeng_processed %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  mutate(
    block_index = cumsum(
      condition != lag(condition, default = first(condition))
    ) + 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-first_trial)
```

### write csv
```{r}
write.csv(zeng_block, "data/processed/zeng_indexed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


# ===============================================================
# 2. Zhang 
### block index
```{r}
zhang_block <- t_zhang_data %>%
  arrange(participant_id) %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  mutate(
    block_index = {
      ## flags where new block starts
      blockstart <- case_when(
        task %in% c("pause", "pause_practice") ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      )
      cumsum(blockstart) + 1
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

### processed
```{r}
zhang_raw <- zhang_block %>%
  select(
    trial_index, participant_id, rt, response, task, block, congruency, correct, block, id, block_index
  )

zhang_processed <- zhang_raw %>%
  mutate(
    cong = case_when(
      congruency == "no_conflict" ~ 1,
      congruency %in% c("low_conflict", "high_conflict") ~ -1
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(task == "response") %>%
  mutate(
    participant_id = paste0(participant_id, "_zhang"),
    study = "zhang"
  ) %>%
  arrange(participant_id, block_index, trial_index) %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_cong = lag(cong, n = 1),
    prev_correct = lag(correct, n = 1),
    is_practice = case_when(
      (block == "practice") ~ 1,
      (is.na(block)) ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-response, -task, -id) %>%
  rename(name = block)
```

### write csv
```{r}
write.csv(zhang_processed, "data/processed/zhang_indexed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


# ===============================================================
# 3. Yang 
### block index
```{r}
yang_raw <- t_yang_data %>%
  arrange(subj_code, trial_index) %>%
  group_by(subj_code) %>%
  mutate(
    feedback = case_when(
      grepl(">✘</div>", stimulus) ~ "visual_punishment", # flagging different feedback events in new variable
      grepl("&#11036", stimulus) ~ "neutral",
      grepl(">✘<br>5 garast veszítettél</div>", stimulus) ~ "monetary_loss",
      grepl("✔", stimulus) ~ "tickmark"
    ),
    prev_feedback = ifelse(task == "probe", lag(feedback, n = 4), ""), # Flagging previous feedback in probe trial
    prev_loss = ifelse(prev_feedback == "monetary_loss", 1, 0), # Flagging if monetary loss happened before this probe
    prev_correct = lag(correct, n = 5), # flagging previous correct
    prev_congruency = lag(congruency, n = 5), # creating previous congruency variable
    block_feedback_type = lead(feedback_type)
  ) %>% # moving feedback type data to probe variable
  ungroup()

yang_block <- yang_raw %>%
  filter(
    task == "probe"
  ) %>%
  group_by(subj_code) %>%
  mutate(
    blockstart = case_when(
      (is.na(prev_congruency)) & (is.na(prev_correct)) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    block_index = cumsum(blockstart)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

### processed
```{r}
yang_processed <- yang_block %>%
  select(
    rt, trial_index, subj_code, congruency, name, correct, prev_correct, prev_congruency, block_index
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    is_practice = ifelse(name == "practice", 1, 0),
    study = "yang",
    subj_code = paste0(subj_code, "_yang"),
    prev_congruency = case_when(
      is.na(prev_congruency) ~ NA_real_,
      prev_congruency == "incongruent" ~ -1,
      TRUE ~ 1
    ),
    congruency = if_else(congruency == "incongruent", -1, 1)
  ) %>%
  rename(cong = congruency,
         prev_cong = prev_congruency,
         participant_id = subj_code)
```

### write csv
```{r}
write.csv(yang_processed, "data/processed/yang_indexed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


# ===============================================================
# 4. Prime-probe
### block index, trial index, type_code (?)
```{r}
primeprobe_processed <- t_primeprobe_data %>%
  mutate(
    source_row_within_study = row_number(),
    study = "primeprobe",
    participant_id = paste0(participant_id, "_primeprobe"),
    trial_index = source_row_within_study,
    block_index = 1L,
    cong = ifelse(is_congruent == 1, 1, -1),
    prev_cong = case_when(
      is.na(prev_congruent) ~ NA_real_,
      prev_congruent == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ -1
    ),
    correct = as.logical(correct),
    prev_correct = lag(correct, n = 1),
    is_first_trial = row_number() == 1L
  ) %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  mutate(
    trial_index = row_number(),
    prev_correct = if_else(row_number() == 1L, NA, lag(correct, n = 1)),
    is_first_trial = row_number() == 1L
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(study, participant_id, trial_index, block_index, cong, prev_cong, rt, correct, prev_correct, is_first_trial, source_row_within_study)
```

### write csv
```{r}
write.csv(primeprobe_processed, "data/processed/primeprobe_indexed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# ===============================================================
# 6. bind_rows and primary CSE eligibility filter
```{r}
flanker_processed$rt <- as.numeric(flanker_processed$rt)
primeprobe_processed$rt <- as.numeric(primeprobe_processed$rt)
yang_processed$rt <- as.numeric(yang_processed$rt)
zhang_processed$rt <- as.numeric(zhang_processed$rt)
zeng_block$rt <- as.numeric(zeng_block$rt)

accuracy_min_overall <- 0.70
accuracy_min_block <- 0.70
condition_cell_min_ratio_threshold <- 0.50

as_boolish <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- tolower(as.character(x))
  case_when(
    x_chr %in% c("true", "1") ~ TRUE,
    x_chr %in% c("false", "0") ~ FALSE,
    TRUE ~ NA
  )
}

all_indexed_unfiltered <- bind_rows(flanker_processed, primeprobe_processed, yang_processed, zhang_processed, zeng_block) %>%
  mutate(
    source_row = row_number(),
    rt = as.numeric(rt),
    cong = as.numeric(cong),
    prev_cong = as.numeric(prev_cong),
    block_index = as.integer(block_index),
    trial_index = as.numeric(trial_index),
    correct_bool = as_boolish(correct),
    prev_correct_bool = as_boolish(prev_correct),
    is_practice_bool = coalesce(as_boolish(is_practice), FALSE) |
      coalesce(tolower(as.character(name)) == "practice", FALSE)
  )

block_first_rows <- all_indexed_unfiltered %>%
  arrange(study, participant_id, coalesce(block_index, 0L), coalesce(trial_index, source_row), source_row) %>%
  group_by(study, participant_id, block_index) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(study, participant_id, block_index, source_row, is_first_trial_block = TRUE)

all_indexed_unfiltered <- all_indexed_unfiltered %>%
  left_join(block_first_rows, by = c("study", "participant_id", "block_index", "source_row")) %>%
  mutate(is_first_trial_block = coalesce(is_first_trial_block, FALSE))

accuracy_base <- all_indexed_unfiltered %>%
  filter(!is_practice_bool, !is.na(correct_bool))

participant_accuracy <- accuracy_base %>%
  group_by(study, participant_id) %>%
  summarise(
    overall_accuracy = mean(correct_bool),
    n_accuracy_trials = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

block_accuracy <- accuracy_base %>%
  group_by(study, participant_id, block_index) %>%
  summarise(
    block_accuracy = mean(correct_bool),
    n_block_accuracy_trials = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

block_instability <- block_accuracy %>%
  group_by(study, participant_id) %>%
  summarise(
    min_block_accuracy = min(block_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_block_below_accuracy_threshold = any(block_accuracy < accuracy_min_block, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

participant_filters_pre_cell <- participant_accuracy %>%
  left_join(block_instability, by = c("study", "participant_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    exclude_low_overall_accuracy = overall_accuracy < accuracy_min_overall,
    exclude_unstable_block_accuracy = coalesce(any_block_below_accuracy_threshold, TRUE),
    exclude_pre_cell = exclude_low_overall_accuracy | exclude_unstable_block_accuracy,
    pre_cell_exclusion_reason = case_when(
      exclude_low_overall_accuracy & exclude_unstable_block_accuracy ~ "low_overall_accuracy;unstable_block_accuracy",
      exclude_low_overall_accuracy ~ "low_overall_accuracy",
      exclude_unstable_block_accuracy ~ "unstable_block_accuracy",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

trial_filtered_pre_cell <- all_indexed_unfiltered %>%
  left_join(
    participant_filters_pre_cell %>% select(study, participant_id, exclude_pre_cell),
    by = c("study", "participant_id")
  ) %>%
  mutate(exclude_pre_cell = coalesce(exclude_pre_cell, TRUE)) %>%
  filter(
    !exclude_pre_cell,
    !is_practice_bool,
    correct_bool,
    prev_correct_bool,
    !is_first_trial_block,
    is.finite(rt),
    rt > 0,
    !is.na(cong),
    !is.na(prev_cong)
  )

condition_cell_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  trial_filtered_pre_cell %>% distinct(study, participant_id),
  cong = c(-1, 1),
  prev_cong = c(-1, 1)
)

condition_cell_counts <- trial_filtered_pre_cell %>%
  count(study, participant_id, cong, prev_cong, name = "cell_n") %>%
  right_join(
    condition_cell_grid,
    by = c("study", "participant_id", "cong", "prev_cong")
  ) %>%
  mutate(cell_n = coalesce(cell_n, 0L))

condition_cell_balance <- condition_cell_counts %>%
  group_by(study, participant_id) %>%
  summarise(
    min_condition_cell_n = min(cell_n),
    max_condition_cell_n = max(cell_n),
    condition_cell_min_ratio = if_else(max_condition_cell_n > 0, min_condition_cell_n / max_condition_cell_n, 0),
    has_complete_condition_matrix = min_condition_cell_n > 0,
    condition_cells_balanced = has_complete_condition_matrix & condition_cell_min_ratio >= condition_cell_min_ratio_threshold,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

participant_filter_summary <- participant_filters_pre_cell %>%
  left_join(condition_cell_balance, by = c("study", "participant_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    exclude_imbalanced_condition_cells = !exclude_pre_cell & !coalesce(condition_cells_balanced, FALSE),
    excluded = exclude_pre_cell | exclude_imbalanced_condition_cells,
    exclusion_reason = case_when(
      pre_cell_exclusion_reason != "" & exclude_imbalanced_condition_cells ~ paste(pre_cell_exclusion_reason, "imbalanced_condition_cells", sep = ";"),
      pre_cell_exclusion_reason != "" ~ pre_cell_exclusion_reason,
      exclude_imbalanced_condition_cells ~ "imbalanced_condition_cells",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

all_indexed <- trial_filtered_pre_cell %>%
  left_join(
    participant_filter_summary %>% select(study, participant_id, exclude_imbalanced_condition_cells),
    by = c("study", "participant_id")
  ) %>%
  filter(!coalesce(exclude_imbalanced_condition_cells, TRUE)) %>%
  select(-exclude_pre_cell, -exclude_imbalanced_condition_cells)

trial_filter_summary <- bind_rows(
  all_indexed_unfiltered %>% mutate(filter_stage = "unfiltered_indexed"),
  all_indexed_unfiltered %>% filter(!is_practice_bool) %>% mutate(filter_stage = "non_practice"),
  trial_filtered_pre_cell %>% mutate(filter_stage = "trial_filtered_pre_cell"),
  all_indexed %>% mutate(filter_stage = "final_cse_eligible")
) %>%
  group_by(filter_stage, study) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_participants = n_distinct(participant_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(all_indexed_unfiltered, "data/processed/all_indexed_unfiltered.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(block_accuracy, "data/processed/block_accuracy.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(condition_cell_counts, "data/processed/condition_cell_counts.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(participant_filter_summary, "data/processed/participant_filter_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(trial_filter_summary, "data/processed/trial_filter_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(all_indexed, "all_indexed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
